monthly.rule: for this run FAULTLAB_MONTHLY_DOLLAR_CAP is lowered to October's committed dollars plus $6.00, so the ledger refuses any call that would spend more than about $6 in total

per_proposal.bound_basis: 8 turns x (32,000 in x $2/M + 4,000 out x $10/M) = $0.832 at Sonnet rates

study.basis: preflight 1 + 153 study trials (6 + 3 controls + 2 slots x 72) at $0.034; 2 proposals at $0.84 equivalent

channel.actor: anthropic API (real money) through app.providers.runtime.RuntimeProvider; every call reserves its bound in the monthly ledger and settles at measured cost
channel.mechanic: claude-code (the owner's subscription through the Claude Agent SDK); no API key

design.referee: legacy (the fixed checks through the bridge, for the C labels)

expected_cost: about $0.30 to $0.40 of API money at the measured cost per trial of the smokes (Haiku, similar prompts)

frozen_design.only_change_from_smoke3: pairs 3 -> 6; the Actor's adapter and channel

machine.keep_awake: held through the desktop app for the session

name: repair-study-api-pilot-2026-10-28
pre_registered_readouts: 1 gap: target findings among valid source controls (n of 6), conformance findings among healthy controls (n of 3)
3 proposals: slots used, valid policies, each verbatim
4 candidate: target findings under L and B0 (n of 3), beliefs, expected class
5 validation: per case, findings, false beliefs, expected class under B0 and L
7 cost: measured vs bound, channel per role, Mechanic tokens

preflight.on_failure: the study is not started; the failure is written up
preflight.pass: the trial's execution is COMPLETED (a scored task outcome, whatever it is) and its measured dollars are recorded
preflight.what: one live dev-5 trial through `faultlab run --adapter model-actor` with the same settings, before the study: the first live run of the model actor on the v2 lab

purpose: The declared API pilot of the repair study (design note build plan step 5), approved by the owner on 2026-10-28 ('okay go ahead'): Haiku 5.5 as Actor on the Anthropic API through the model-actor adapter (the legacy reference Actor's prompt, the Actor of phase B, where Haiku slipped on dev-5 through C5 in 12 of 24 trials), Sonnet 5.5 as Mechanic on Claude Code (the subscription), the design frozen at 6e179d0, six pairs.
stop_rules: the preflight must pass before the study starts
every batch is capped at its trials' bound; admission refuses beyond it
the monthly ledger refuses any call past the pilot's process cap (about $6 of new spend)
a trial ends at 8 model calls, 18 HTTP attempts or 90 wall seconds
a Mechanic session ends at 8 turns
a 402, credit or billing message in the logs stops the run
the run is killed if it exceeds 90 minutes wall time
